build.beforeDevCommand: cargo build -p daemon --bin gokod && pnpm dev
build.beforeBuildCommand: mkdir -p src-tauri/binaries && if [ "$TAURI_ENV_TARGET_TRIPLE" = "universal-apple-darwin" ]; then cargo build -p daemon --bin gokod --release --target aarch64-apple-darwin && cargo build -p daemon --bin gokod --release --target x86_64-apple-darwin && lipo -create ../../target/aarch64-apple-darwin/release/gokod ../../target/x86_64-apple-darwin/release/gokod -output src-tauri/binaries/gokod-universal-apple-darwin; else cargo build -p daemon --bin gokod --release --target "$TAURI_ENV_TARGET_TRIPLE" && cp ../../target/$TAURI_ENV_TARGET_TRIPLE/release/gokod src-tauri/binaries/gokod-$TAURI_ENV_TARGET_TRIPLE; fi && pnpm build

security.csp: default-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' asset: http://asset.localhost data: blob:; font-src 'self' data:
security.devCsp: default-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost http://localhost:5173 ws://localhost:5173; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' asset: http://asset.localhost data: blob:; font-src 'self' data:
